newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine unemployment seen declining 2-4 points.
newsitem.headline: Argentine unemployment seen declining 2-4 points.

text.p: Argentina's unemployment, currently at a near record level of 17.3 percent, could decline between 2-4 percentage points this year, a senior government official said in an interview published Sunday.
"An important number of jobs will be created this year," Economic Planning Secretary Eugenio Pendas told the daily Pagina 12.
Asked if unemployment could slip by two points as has been predicted, Pendas said, "That is a conservative prediction, a floor that can be met. It will probably be four (points)."
The official said the government was considering lowering the value added tax, slashing labor costs and revamping the tax system to make it more equitable.
Pendas also pledged there would be no deviations from the country's austerity program despite Congressional elections later this year.
"We expect them (the politicians) to ask for more funds and we will tell them there is no money."
